## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: An escalation_request moves exactly one rung up the ladder and records the...

The system SHALL ensure that an escalation_request moves exactly one rung up the ladder and records the rung, reason, and ledger refs in the dispatch result.

#### Scenario: An escalation_request moves exactly one rung up the ladder and records the...

WHEN `implement-the-evidence-backed-escalation-ladder` is implemented
THEN An escalation_request moves exactly one rung up the ladder and records the rung, reason, and ledger refs in the dispatch result.

### Requirement: A rung that policy auto-approves runs without a human decision, and a rung...

The system SHALL ensure that a rung that policy auto-approves runs without a human decision, and a rung policy does not cover raises a decision card in the inbox.

#### Scenario: A rung that policy auto-approves runs without a human decision, and a rung...

WHEN `implement-the-evidence-backed-escalation-ladder` is implemented
THEN A rung that policy auto-approves runs without a human decision, and a rung policy does not cover raises a decision card in the inbox.

### Requirement: The human-rung decision card links the evidence ledger entries accumulated...

The system SHALL ensure that the human-rung decision card links the evidence ledger entries accumulated across all previous rungs.

#### Scenario: The human-rung decision card links the evidence ledger entries accumulated...

WHEN `implement-the-evidence-backed-escalation-ladder` is implemented
THEN The human-rung decision card links the evidence ledger entries accumulated across all previous rungs.

### Requirement: The ladder never skips the cross-vendor rung before the human rung unless...

The system SHALL ensure that the ladder never skips the cross-vendor rung before the human rung unless the governor reports no cross-vendor headroom, and that skip is recorded.

#### Scenario: The ladder never skips the cross-vendor rung before the human rung unless...

WHEN `implement-the-evidence-backed-escalation-ladder` is implemented
THEN The ladder never skips the cross-vendor rung before the human rung unless the governor reports no cross-vendor headroom, and that skip is recorded.
